name: Samba (SMB) Storage Destination
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Back up containers to a Samba (SMB) share via TCP (port 445) using hirochachacha/go-smb2. Three auth modes: guest (configurable guest account, requires `guest ok = yes` on the share), basic (NTLMv2 workgroup user + password), and domain (NTLMv2 with explicit Windows domain). Same Test round-trip shape as the built-in local destination (credentials / write / change / delete).
